deploybot: [deploy-start] Canary deploy 'silverwave' started — env=prod-usw, release=v2.9.0-silverwave, tag=silverwave-2026-03-20, commit=ab12f9d, traffic=5% :rocket:

maria: ack. I'm on-call for prod-usw today, watching latency and 5xx.

deploy-observability-bot: smoke checks: ok. latency p95=180ms, errors=0/1m. logs -> https://internal.logs/redwood/prod-usw/silverwave

tony: seeing a spike in 502s for /api/chat at 5% traffic; +1 alert in PagerDuty

sam: can you paste the docker tag? i want to check service diff

deploybot: tag: silverwave-2026-03-20 (image: ghcr.io/redwood/inference:ab12f9d). rolling back to 100% baseline if rollback command issued.

eva: quick grep in logs suggests new model runtime failing kvcache warmup for some instances, 502s originate from inference-runtime-2. Will run a hotfix loop.

maria: let's hold the ramp. deploybot: hold and scale-down to 2% traffic, pin old tag on 50% pool. explain in roll note.

deploybot: [action] traffic set to 2%, pinned tag baseline v2.8.7 on pool B, new canary instances isolated. Notifying eng-sre.

sam: runs the quick rollback test - ran `./tools/deploy rollback --env prod-usw --tag silverwave-2026-03-20 --dry-run` output ok

eva: hotfix pushed, kvcache warmup guard added. monitoring for 10m.

deploy-observability-bot: after hotfix: 502s down to baseline; p95=175ms, errors=1/5m

maria: ok to resume ramp to 30% in 10min if metrics stay stable. anyone object? :raised_hands:

tony: no objections, will keep PagerDuty on watch

deploybot: ramping to 30% traffic now.

deploy-observability-bot: smoke checks passing at 30% after 7m

maria: promote to 100%? recommend gradual: 30 -> 60 -> 100 over 15m

sam: LGTM. Would prefer tagging release-notes with the hotfix mention.

deploybot: [promote] Canary 'silverwave' promoted to 100% in prod-usw, final tag=silverwave-2026-03-20, pinned release v2.9.0-silverwave. Release notes: "Added kvcache warmup guard; addressed intermittent 502s on /api/chat."

deploybot: closing thread. changelog: https://confluence.internal/redwood/releases/v2.9.0-silverwave
